results.title: Mother of man killed in Erie County Holding Center sues the county
results.description: Attorneys representing Nadia Pizarro filed a notice of claim Thursday that alleges the wrongful death of her son, Antonio Pizarro, who was killed July 4 at the Erie County Holding Center.

results.title: Gunman accused in Dooky Chase killing deemed mentally incompetent to go to trial for now
results.description: The alleged Dooky Chase shooter was ruled mentally unfit to stand trial and ordered to undergo treatment at a state-run mental health facility Thursday.

results.title: New $7M senior center opens to fanfare; regular use won't start until Oct. 19
results.description: Years of effort by city and county officials and members of the Senior Community Center of Owensboro-Daviess County culminated Thursday when leaders from the agencies cut the ribbon and opened the new senior center facility to visitors.

results.title: Newsom Signs Law Bringing Abortion Pills to California Community College Campuses

results.title: State laws on intoxication and consent get new scrutiny after Cornell rape allegations
results.description: Under New York state law, rape charges generally need to involve force or a clear refusal of sex, unless the victim is physically helpless due to being unconscious, or mentally incapacitated due to being drugged without their consent.
